variant_decisions.evidence: ASV 'because I follow the thing that is good' renders an infinitive-with-suffix sense ('my pursuing good') that both the qere רָדְפִי and the ketiv רדופי (read as רְדוֹפִי) yield identically; no italicized supply and no textual note on the verse. Qere base fallback retained.
